text:
maya (Product Marketing): Hey team — quick sync on the partner guest post + demo capture flow. want to lock the go/no-go for the drip sequence and routing.
carlos (Partnerships): Love it. Partner legal cleared the guest draft yesterday, they added a short technical appendix.
li (Growth): Can we make the blog CTA point to a single demo landing page so tracking is clean? One UTM and one form.
sophia (Marketing Ops): Agreed. I can spin up the landing page this afternoon. Need confirmation on required fields for routing.
jordan (Sales BD): Must include: company, role, expected monthly usage, and whether they want an on-prem/private eval. That last one steps into AE handoff.
maya (Product Marketing): Good call. Suggested form fields: name, email, company, role, use case, expected scale, demo cadence preference, "interested in private/dedicated" checkbox.
carlos (Partnerships): Partner wants co-branded header and a short blurb above the form saying "Schedule a joint technical demo with us + Redwood". OK?
li (Growth): Yes, also add a hidden field for the partner_source so we can attribute. UTM will be fine but hidden field prevents dropped params.
sophia (Marketing Ops): Routing rules draft: if partner_source == "nebula" -> HubSpot list "Nebula inbound" and assign owner based on company size. Small < $5k ARR => SDR queue, > $5k => jordan.AE. I'll codify with workflow. Anyone object?
jordan (Sales BD): Fine. For private/dedicated checkbox = true -> escalate to enterprise queue and sync a ticket in Salesforce, notify #eng-sre for potential capacity planning.
maya (Product Marketing): Webinar follow-up plan: blog publishes Mon, then 3-email drip over 10 days: 1) post + TL;DR, 2) short technical excerpt + invite to on-demand demo, 3) case study + CTA to schedule live co-demo. Li — can you draft subject lines?
li (Growth): Drafts: 1) "New: How we sped up inference for GenAI apps (guest post)", 2) "Deep dive: kv-cache and batching tips — demo inside", 3) "See it live: joint demo + implementation checklist". Thoughts?
carlos (Partnerships): I like the second one — partner engineers want the tech hooks. Also request: include partner social handles in email footer.
sophia (Marketing Ops): I'll set up drip in HubSpot with 3-day spacing, add opens click filters for accelerated sales nudges. Also will add workflow to add "hot_lead" tag if they click schedule link more than once.
maya (Product Marketing): Promo channels: organic social (Redwood + partner), partner newsletter, paid retargeting for viewers who hit the blog but don't submit form. Li, add paid to budget ask.
li (Growth): Will do. Budget ask: small test $1,500 for retargeting in NA + EMEA split.
jordan (Sales BD): For lead triage, can we add one manual QA check per day? Ops-bot should summary-post new high-intent leads to #sales-notify.
ops-bot: Scheduled workflow created: daily digest at 9am PST for "hot_lead" entries. Trigger: HubSpot list "GuestBlog-HighIntent".
sophia (Marketing Ops): Quick tech note: landing page will use script to preserve UTM across navigation and set hidden partner_source param. I will attach the form JSON to the campaign doc.
maya (Product Marketing): Who's own the demo calendar for partner-led sessions? Jordan or Carlos?
carlos (Partnerships): We should let partner run initial sched for co-demo but require AE confirmation. Jordan will review and accept or propose alternate times within 24h.
jordan (Sales BD): Works for me. Also request a canned intro email template for co-demo handoff. Sophia — can you add it to Playbooks?
sophia (Marketing Ops): Yep. I'll add templates: "intro-to-AE", "co-demo-confirm", and "post-demo follow-up".
li (Growth): One more ask: add an experiment param to the CTA links so we can A/B subject lines and CTA copy. I want to test "Schedule a 20-min co-demo" vs "Request a technical walkthrough".
maya (Product Marketing): Good. Let's ship this timeline: landing + form + routing rules today, blog publish Mon, email drip starts Tue, retargeting begins Wed. Any blockers?
carlos (Partnerships): Partner asking for an embargo until partner legal approves social assets — should be done today.
sophia (Marketing Ops): No blockers from ops side. I'll post a checklist in the campaign doc and ping when landing is live.
jordan (Sales BD): I'll prep the AE thread and the Slack shortcut for quick accept/decline.
maya (Product Marketing): Perfect. Action items: Sophia builds landing & workflows (owner), Li finalizes paid budget + AB tests, Jordan preps AE handoff + Slack shortcut, Carlos finalizes partner assets, Maya finalizes blog copy and sends to partner for social copy.
li (Growth): I'll drop the budget sheet into the campaign doc when done.
ops-bot: Note: campaign tracking tag "guest_blog_nebula_v1" created.
maya (Product Marketing): Thanks all — low-touch check-in tomorrow 11am PT. :thumbsup:
